next.reason: 1985: '[ MEMORY SIZE integer-1 {WORDS|CHARACTERS|MODULES} ] [ PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS alphabet-name-1 ] [ SEGMENT-LIMIT IS segment-number ]'; 2023: 'OBJECT-COMPUTER. [computer-name-1] [CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION ...] [PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE ... FOR NATIONAL ...] .'. The 2023 format keeps computer-name and PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE but drops MEMORY SIZE and the segmentation SEGMENT-LIMIT clause, so programs using them are refused.
